name: Kohana Shinjushitsu
source:
Kohana Shinjushitsu (a stage name that means a child of flowers born from the mother of pearl) is a highly famous Lolita fashion model, trying all types of Lolita fashion from OTT sweet to gothic to classic to steampunk. You name it, Kohana has modelled it. While generally loved by the media, she is usually hated by those also in the lolita fashion community.

Little is known about Kohana's personality as every interview she does seems rather artificial or like she isn't the actual one talking. There are various theories that have spawned due to this. Some suggest she's actually incredibly vulgar and despises the clothes she's made to wear, some say she has incredible amounts of stage fright, some say she's insecure about her height, some say that she stole all her first brand pieces, some say she's incredibly bratty, some say she spreads rumours and is mean to her fellow members of the lolita fashion community, and some even say she's a boy!

All of these are silly rumours. A sort of subculture has evolved around trying to expose Kohana and dig up dirt on her but they're all false rumours with very little credibility.

Right?

[From [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CZU9MfIt8-7/]official Instagram[/url]]
